scope: host checks of the source-resilience modules (roadmap step 13): injected failures, a loopback server, one network-less namespace; no phone, rig or live-service evidence

rows.scenario: unavailable package repository: preserved copy used, tampered copy refused, no copy fails typed
rows.expected: build finishes from preserved bytes; tamper and missing are errors
rows.observed: preserved build ok; tampered and missing raise OSError

rows.scenario: missing primary add-on and every add-on backup: first-party searches take over
rows.expected: results from the ten site searches, add-ons never launched
rows.observed: 3 candidates from site searches; 0 add-on calls

rows.scenario: dead remote configuration / all sites down: typed offline, not empty
rows.expected: typed offline outcome and no results

rows.scenario: dead aggregator (Knaben) while others answer
rows.expected: others answer; aggregator reported offline and cooled down

rows.scenario: shared backend failure: two add-on providers fail for the same reason
rows.expected: chain continues to a third provider; both cool down

rows.scenario: DNS failure (real resolver, .invalid host)
rows.expected: typed offline

rows.scenario: TLS failure (real handshake against a self-signed local server)
rows.expected: typed offline; certificate is not accepted

rows.scenario: complete offline mode (network-less namespace, real sockets)
rows.expected: typed offline for every request; staged bundle still imports and searches fixtures

rows.scenario: malformed feeds and pages for every site family
rows.expected: every family: layout changed, never a fabricated result

rows.scenario: expired link: re-resolved once, second expiry returns expired
rows.expected: one re-resolve, then expired; no loop

rows.scenario: 403/429 from a site and from the debrid service
rows.expected: typed refused; cooldown honours Retry-After; debrid circuit needs three service failures

rows.scenario: absent peers: no swarm starts
rows.expected: timeout within the total bound; player stopped; each swarm cooled

rows.scenario: missing accounts: no AllDebrid key and no Google sign-in path
rows.expected: typed account-required; direct route offered only behind the prompt
rows.observed: account-required; direct plan allowed (prompt still required)

rows.scenario: wrong movie, wrong year, wrong episode, duplicate results
rows.expected: only the exact title/year/episode; duplicates collapse by hash
rows.observed: 3 movie candidates, no wrong-year/title rows, no wrong-episode rows

rows.scenario: partial success: some families fail, one answers
rows.expected: results kept with a per-site report

rows.scenario: all results empty is a valid outcome
rows.expected: empty, never fabricated success

rows.scenario: cancellation never advances or penalises
rows.expected: canceled outcome; nothing recorded in health; no player start
rows.observed: no advance, no record, no start

rows.scenario: profile restart: health, token mirror and stale metadata survive
rows.expected: state reloads from the profile files
rows.observed: cooldown, mirrored key and own key persist

rows.scenario: concurrent jobs: parallel searches share health; same stream starts once
rows.expected: no exception, consistent health, one player start
rows.observed: 8 parallel searches ok; duplicate starts collapsed (1 player starts)

rows.scenario: sports: stale, ambiguous and ended games rejected
rows.expected: typed unsupported/empty; no launch

rows.scenario: no direct torrent traffic is attempted by any search or fallback path
rows.expected: zero non-loopback connections recorded by the tripwire

rows.scenario: no secret-bearing line: logs, health file, notices and reports carry no key or link
rows.expected: zero lines contain the key, a URL, a header or a magnet
rows.observed: 6 log lines, 1 notices, health file: clean

rows.scenario: the repository carries no key, token file or private state from these steps
rows.expected: no secret pattern in the new modules, docs or reports

rows.scenario: the app never runs downloaded code
rows.expected: update flow has no exec/eval/import of downloaded data

rows.scenario: no abandoned background jobs after the whole matrix
rows.expected: thread count back to baseline
